semantic_spotlight.description: Meta/LTX interprets named subjects and moves restrained light between them; deterministic code owns all text.
semantic_spotlight.prompt_template: {source_description}. Keep the camera static. {treatment} {focus_sequence}. {ambient_motion}. Preserve the exact historical composition. Do not add or remove people or animals or objects or text.

archival_evidence_scan.description: A light-based visual investigation moves through named evidence regions without procedural circles.
archival_evidence_scan.prompt_template: {source_description}. Keep the camera static. A narrow museum examination light moves in sequence across {focus_sequence}. {ambient_motion}. Preserve every mark and figure in the source. Do not add or remove content or text.

living_archive.description: Ambient historical motion without semantic overlays or changed source content.
living_archive.prompt_template: {source_description}. Keep the camera static. {ambient_motion}. Preserve the exact historical composition. Do not add or remove people or animals or objects or text.
